create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object with a specified start node for building a finite state transducer
add_node_to_graph: add a node to a gtn Graph with optional start and end flags to define states
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn Graph with a symbol label for transitions
draw_gtn_graph: draw a gtn Graph to a PDF file with symbol labels for visualization
union_gtn_graphs: union multiple gtn Graph objects into a single combined graph using gtn.union
